, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that southeastern Britain was conquered by the Roman Republic (citing Julius Caesar’s 55–54 BC expeditions) instead of the Roman Empire under Claudius in AD 43, conflating brief invasions with the actual conquest and contradicting earlier findings.
